definitions.explanation: Performances carried out in public spaces such as streets, parks, or plazas. Includes juggling, acrobatics, magic, music, mime, and other acts performed for passersby.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}で{大道芸|だいどうげい}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a street performance in the park.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}の{駅前|えきまえ}で{大道芸|だいどうげい}をやっている{人|ひと}がいた。
examples.english: There was someone doing a street performance in front of the station on the weekend.

examples.japanese: この{街|まち}では{毎年|まいとし}{大道芸|だいどうげい}フェスティバルが{開|ひら}かれ、{世界中|せかいじゅう}からパフォーマーが{集|あつ}まる。
examples.english: Every year this city holds a street performance festival, attracting performers from around the world.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {大道|だいどう} (main road, street) and {芸|げい} (performance art). The performer is called {大道芸人|だいどうげいにん}. Japan has a notable street performance culture, with events like the Shizuoka Daidougei World Cup being well known.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大道芸人|だいどうげいにん}: street performer
- {大道芸|だいどうげい}フェスティバル: street performance festival
- {大道芸|だいどうげい}を{披露|ひろう}する: to showcase street performance
- {大道芸|だいどうげい}を{見|み}る: to watch street performance
